name: Outbound reply triage
description: Sort replies to outbound email or LinkedIn sequences so reps only open the ones that need them.

reply_type.instructions: What is the sender doing in this reply?

criteria.unsubscribe: Asks to stop emailing or be removed from the list
criteria.not_interested: Says no, with no request to be removed
criteria.not_now: Interested in principle but asks to reconnect later
criteria.referral: Points to a different person to talk to
criteria.question: Asks a question about the product, price or company before deciding
criteria.interested: Wants a meeting, demo or next step now

names_another_person.instructions: The reply names or copies another person who should be contacted instead.
